appDescription.message: Ask in plain language and let an AI assistant read, fill in and act on the page you are viewing.

emptyTitle.message: What would you like to do?

emptyBody.message: Describe it in your own words. The assistant reads the page you are on and works from there.

sendHint.message: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line

statusLoadingModel.message: Loading the model — the first request after a restart is slow

navBody.message: The assistant wants to open {domain} in this tab.

noticeStoppedPageChanged.message: Stopped: the page changed while the assistant was working. Ask again to continue on the new page.

noticeResumed.message: Picked this conversation back up from a tab you closed.

noticeProviderChanged.message: Switched to {provider}. This service speaks a different protocol, so the conversation starts fresh.

errNoProvider.message: No AI service set up yet.

errNoEndpoint.message: This service has no address configured.

errBadKey.message: The API key was refused. Check it in settings.

errNoCredit.message: The account has no credit left with this provider.

errBadEndpoint.message: The service address returned nothing. Check the URL in settings.

errProviderDown.message: The provider is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.

errTimeout.message: The model sent nothing for {seconds}s. If it runs on your machine, it may still be loading — try again.

errEmptyResponse.message: The model returned nothing twice in a row. Try rewording your request.

errContextTooLong.message: This conversation no longer fits in the model’s context, even trimmed. Start a new conversation, or use a model with a larger window.

noticeContextTrimmed.message: The conversation was too long for this model — older steps were dropped and the step retried.

providerNone.message: No AI service yet. Add one to start using BrowserMind.

providerRemoveConfirm.message: Remove this service and its API key?

providerThinkingHint.message: Slower and more expensive, better on tricky pages. Override per message with /think or /nothink.

providerThinkingPromptHint.message: This server has no setting for it, so /think is added to your message — a convention several local models follow.

providerVision.message: Let the assistant look at the page

providerVisionHint.message: Only for models that read images. Turn it off and the screenshot tool is not offered. Override per message with /vision or /novision.

wizardNeedKey.message: BrowserMind uses your own account with the AI service. Get a key, paste it here, and it stays on this computer.

wizardUrlHint.message: The address up to /v1 — for example http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama.

wizardModelHint.message: You can change this later at any time.

testBadKey.message: This key was refused by the service.

testNoCredit.message: The key works but the account has no credit.

testRateLimited.message: Too many requests right now — try again shortly.

testProviderDown.message: The service is having trouble. Try again later.

testNetwork.message: Could not reach the service. Check your connection or the address.

testNoModel.message: Pick a model to test with.

optHighlightHint.message: Outlines each element on the page as the assistant acts on it.

optInstructionsHint.message: Anything you want the assistant to always keep in mind.

optInstructionsPlaceholder.message: e.g. Always answer in metric units. Prefer official sources.

optMaxStepsHint.message: A safety limit on long tasks. The assistant pauses and asks before going further.

optNavAlways.message: Allow the assistant to change site without asking

optMemory.message: Let the assistant remember things about you

optDebugHint.message: Adds a diagnostics panel useful when reporting a problem.

privacyNote.message: Your API key and your conversations stay on this computer. Page content is sent only to the AI service you configured.
